questions.stem: Which one of the following statements best describes 'constitutionalism' as distinct from a Constitution?
options: It is the codified single document that lays down the framework of government
It is the collection of conventions and judicial decisions in an unwritten set-up
It is the doctrine that the powers of the State must be subject to specific limits laid down by the Constitution
It is the process by which a Constitution is amended by the legislature
questions.subject: Polity

questions.stem: In a parliamentary system such as India's, which one of the following is a defining feature?
options: The executive is not responsible to the legislature
Ministers must be members of the legislature
There is a strict separation of powers between the executive and legislature
The head of the executive is elected for a fixed term and cannot be removed by the legislature
questions.subject: Polity

questions.stem: India is described as 'quasi-federal'. Which one of the following is a UNITARY feature of the Indian Constitution?
options: An independent judiciary headed by the Supreme Court
Bicameralism with a Rajya Sabha representing the states
Residuary powers vested in the Union and a single citizenship
questions.subject: Polity

questions.stem: Article 1 of the Constitution describes India as a 'Union of States'. This phrasing primarily signifies that
options: the states have no right to secede from the Union
India is a confederation of sovereign states
states can alter their own boundaries without Parliament
the Union derives its authority from the states
questions.subject: Polity

questions.stem: The doctrine of 'basic structure' of the Constitution was propounded in which one of the following cases?

a special majority of Parliament only
approval of the Rajya Sabha alone
a special majority of Parliament plus ratification by half of the state legislatures
